Biancana

Condominium in Surin
HomeSaleBiancana

Project overview

Four five-storey residential buildings between Surin and Bang Tao beaches, with 343 units on about 12,300 sqm. Construction was reported at about 3% in October 2026.

Units range from 1-bedroom to 3-bedroom penthouses. Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.

Biancana: key facts

  • Biancana is a condominium in Surin, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).
  • Units: 1–3 bedrooms, 31–131 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Mar 2028.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿5,513,000.
  • Nearest beach: Surin Beach (47 m / under 1 minute, driving).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (3.0 km, straight line); Thalang Hospital (8.5 km, straight line); Tesco Lotus (2.7 km, straight line); Big C (3.1 km, straight line).
  • More projects by Rhom Bho Property in our catalogue: Darayana Kamala, The Title Cocoon, The Title Adora Rawai, Casa De Monte, Coralina Kamala, The Title Fizz.
